entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Yang Huai was a general military serving under Liu Zhang, ruler of Yi Province, during the Three Kingdoms period of China.

As a key figure in the Jin Dynasty, Yang Huai played a crucial role in the province's defense against invading forces, utilizing innovative tactics such as the 'turtle shell' formation to repel enemy attacks.

His military strategies were influenced by the Han Dynasty's emphasis on discipline and unity, and he is remembered for his bravery and tactical genius.

Yang Huai's legacy extends beyond his military prowess, as he was also a patron of the arts and a supporter of Buddhist monasteries.

In the words of his contemporary, Yang Xin, 'Yang Huai was a man of unwavering courage and unshakeable loyalty, whose military prowess was matched only by his wisdom and compassion.'
